calibration_note: Expert synthesis calibrated to Farkas/ANSUR-type chord norms of young adults of one reference population; unknown-population use inflates the covariance by kappa (anat R4.4). Never conditioned on the subject's population (anat R7.4).

defaults_provenance.rigid_invariance: DESIGN 4.6 G Lambda_g G^T: translation sigma 100 mm, rotation sigma 0.5 rad (badge 🆕)
defaults_provenance.scale_sigma_log: DESIGN D-03, 4.7: zeta ~ N(0, 0.045^2), the single population size source (badge 🧠)
defaults_provenance.tragion_floor_mm: DESIGN 4.6 R_floor: tragion definition noise; source has zero variance by frame construction (badge 🆕)

frame: FH; origin mid-tragion; +x subject left, +y up, +z forward; mm
loadings_note: rows 3*i + axis (x, y, z); columns follow factor_names; sigma NOT applied; size column = mean (CV units)
residual_note: residual_asym is 0 for midline ids (no pair); residual_cov = diag(total^2) with L/R off-diagonal blocks diag((total^2 - asym^2) * [-1, 1, 1])
